### Sinusoidal AC voltage
<left>
[picture:878:a_phasenwinkel_zeit:Phase angle in degrees and radians, or as a fraction of the period]
</left>
<right>
* Generated by a coil rotating in a magnetic field
* One revolution takes a certain time
* At every instant the coil is at a certain angle $\rightarrow$ *phase angle*
</right>

### Phase shift

<left>
[picture:208:a_phasenverschiebung:Phase shift between two sinusoidal signals]
</left>
<right>
* Phase shift describes the offset in time between two periodic signals of the same frequency
* It is usually given in degrees (°) or radians
* A phase shift between current and voltage can be caused, for example, by components such as capacitors or inductors
</right>
